about.short: I am Akhand Raj — Akki — a software developer focused on backend engineering, software architecture, and building modular systems.
about.full: I enjoy understanding how systems work, solving architectural problems, and turning complex ideas into clean, maintainable software. My path into software started with hands-on technical work, followed by teaching programming, software development, and backend engineering. I learn primarily by building real software, experimenting with different approaches, and understanding the trade-offs behind technical decisions. Outside software, I enjoy sketching, archery, chess, and exploring ideas beyond my usual technical interests.
